sections.title: Growing *slowly, on purpose*
body: Heather Willaby spent her days helping other people launch businesses before opening The Parlour in Eastside Village. Brad Gutierrez, a Marine Corps veteran, is her partner.
The shop opened with coffee and pre-packaged treats, and now bakes its own pastries and makes full lunches. "We are trying to grow slowly so that we don't overwhelm ourselves," Heather says.

Listings give three different closing times, and Visit Aiken files the shop under another restaurant's old web address
The words on this concept come from WRDW and the Aiken Standard; the menu, photos and hours would come from the owner
after: A site the business owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
